comparison.objective: Restock a spring-pusher lane while holding the pusher retracted; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual spring restraint and carton placement versus tool-mediated unlocking, fine rotary adjustment, relocking, and cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Four cartons ordered in-lane with pusher returned versus two acceptable impact stops. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift criteria are partly undeclared.
comparison.reason: The spring-loaded mechanisms share force handling but test different manipulation and outcomes.
